arXiv:2603.26299v1 [cs.CV] 2026 年 3 月 27 日arXiv:2603.26299v1 [cs.CV] 27 Mar 2026

优先对齐的 LoRA 合并：保留子空间覆盖并解决方向各向异性Preference-Aligned LoRA Merging: Preserving Subspace Coverage and Addressing Directional Anisotropy

Wooseong Jeong∗
KAIST
stk14570@kaist.ac.kr    Wonyoung Lee∗
KAIST
wylee@kaist.ac.kr    Kuk-Jin Yoon
KAIST
kjyoon@kaist.ac.kr
摘要Abstract

合并多个低秩适应（LoRA）模块有望构建通用系统， 但具有挑战性，因为 LoRA 更新方向跨越不同的子空间并且贡献不均匀。 当天真地合并时，这种不匹配可能会削弱对某些任务损失最关键的方向，同时过分强调相对不太重要的方向，最终降低模型忠实表示所有任务的能力。我们通过两个角度重新审视这个问题：子空间覆盖，它捕获了 LoRA 方向覆盖不同表征方向的广泛程度；以及各向异性，它反映了这些方向上影响力的不平衡。 我们建议 TARA 合并（Merging multiple Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) modules is promising for constructing general-purpose systems, yet challenging because LoRA update directions span different subspaces and contribute unevenly. When merged naively, such mismatches can weaken the directions most critical to certain task losses while overemphasizing relatively less important ones, ultimately reducing the model’s ability to represent all tasks faithfully. We revisit this problem through two perspectives: subspace coverage, which captures how broadly LoRA directions cover diverse representational directions, and anisotropy, which reflects the imbalance of influence across those directions. We propose TARA-Merging (任务等级各向异性对齐Task-Rank Anisotropy Alignment），它使用偏好加权交叉熵伪损失来对齐合并权重，同时保留与任务相关的 LoRA 子空间。这确保了广泛的子空间覆盖并通过方向重新加权减轻各向异性。 在八个视觉和六个 NLI 基准中，TARA-Merging 始终优于普通和 LoRA 感知基线，表现出强大的鲁棒性和泛化性，并强调了 LoRA 合并中解决子空间覆盖和各向异性的重要性。 代码可在), which aligns merging weights using a preference-weighted cross-entropy pseudo-loss while preserving task-relevant LoRA subspaces. This ensures broad subspace coverage and mitigates anisotropy via direction-wise reweighting. Across eight vision and six NLI benchmarks, TARA-Merging consistently outperforms vanilla and LoRA-aware baselines, demonstrating strong robustness and generalization, and highlighting the importance of addressing both subspace coverage and anisotropy in LoRA merging. Code is available athttps://github.com/wooseong97/TARA-Merge.

1 简介Introduction

低阶适应（LoRA）Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)[29]广泛用于使大型基础模型适应下游任务，包括大型语言模型和视觉语言模型，例如 CLIPis widely used to adapt large foundation models to downstream tasks, including large language models and vision-language models such as CLIP[72]。通过引入轻量级低秩适配器，LoRA 能够以更少的可训练参数和更低的内存开销实现高效微调，同时降低仅可用数据有限时过度拟合的风险。这种效率鼓励在许多不同的数据集上训练单独的 LoRA 适配器，每个数据集捕获视觉或语言理解的不同方面。将特定于任务的 LoRA 模块组合到单个网络中属于以下范式. By introducing lightweight low-rank adapters, LoRA enables efficient fine-tuning with far fewer trainable parameters and reduced memory overhead, while mitigating the risk of overfitting when only limited data are available. This efficiency has encouraged training separate LoRA adapters on many different datasets, each capturing distinct aspects of vision or language understanding. Combining task-specific LoRA modules into a single network falls under the paradigm of模型合并model merging [101]，它为昂贵的多任务训练提供了一个有吸引力的替代方案, which provides an attractive alternative to costly multi-task training[36, 38, 37, 35]并能够构建通用模型，灵活地集成跨任务的知识并反映不同的任务偏好。and enables the construction of general-purpose models that flexibly integrate knowledge across tasks and reflect different task preferences.

最近的研究探索了各种模型合并。早期基线，例如任务算术Recent research has explored various model merging. Early baselines such as task arithmetic[32, 68, 39]将微调模型视为线性更新，并通过线性组合将它们组合起来。联系融合treat fine-tuned models as linear updates and combine them through a linear combination. Ties-merging[99]和敢于and DARE[107]通过丢弃参数来减少干扰，而 AdaMergingreduces interference by dropping parameters, while AdaMerging[105]使用从基于熵的替代损失导出的梯度来调整合并系数。最近的工作专门针对 LoRA 的模型合并。诺特adapts merging coefficients using gradients derived from an entropy-based surrogate loss. Recent work has targeted model merging specifically for LoRA. KnOTS[79]使用共享 SVD 基础和 LoRA-LEGO 对齐适配器aligns adapters using a shared SVD basis, and LoRA-LEGO[114]对按等级的单元进行聚类以保持模块化。 专注于 LoRA 适配器是有前途的，因为 LoRA 微调已成为现代 LLM 和 VLM 的标准做法。 此外，与合并完整模型权重相比，在适配器级别进行操作大大减少了内存和计算开销，甚至使基于梯度的方法（例如 AdaMerging）能够扩展到基础模型。 此外，虽然已经提出了几种方法，但它们常常忽略了我们在这项工作中强调的两个基本挑战中的至少一个，即保留子空间覆盖和解决方向各向异性。clusters rank-wise units to preserve modularity. Focusing on LoRA adapters is promising, as LoRA fine-tuning has become standard practice for modern LLMs and VLMs. Moreover, operating at the adapter level substantially reduces memory and compute overhead compared to merging full model weights, enabling even gradient-based approaches such as AdaMerging to scale to foundation models. In addition, While several approaches have been proposed, they often overlook at least one of the two fundamental challenges we emphasize in this work, namely preserving subspace coverage and addressing directional anisotropy.

LoRA 产生一个低等级更新，我们将其分解为按等级进行分析的组件。我们将这些方向统称为LoRA produces a low-rank update that we decompose into rank-wise components for analysis. We collectively term these directions asLoRA 方向LoRA directions。通过此设置，成功合并的两个方面至关重要：. With this setup, two aspects are essential for successful merging:子空间覆盖subspace coverage和and各向异性anisotropy。子空间覆盖范围捕获 LoRA 方向共同跨越代表性子空间的范围，因此保留覆盖范围可确保访问不同的任务相关信息。各向异性是指方向灵敏度不平衡。即使有足够的覆盖范围，任务损失对不同 LoRA 方向的敏感度也不同，如果忽视，可能会扭曲权衡。此外，当指定任务偏好时，有效的合并必须保留覆盖范围，同时根据这些偏好调整合并权重。大多数合并方法仅解决问题的一方面。任务算术和修剪减少了干扰，但侵蚀了子空间覆盖范围并忽略了方向敏感性。 AdaMerging 调整了全局权重，但忽略了每个方向的各向异性。 KnOTS 和 LoRA-LEGO 等 LoRA 感知方法改进了结构，但会缩小有效覆盖范围，并且仍然缺乏灵敏度加权。简而言之，它们不会共同保留 LoRA 方向上的覆盖范围和各向异性模型。. Subspace coverage captures how widely the LoRA directions collectively span the representational subspace, so preserving coverage ensures access to diverse task-relevant information. Anisotropy refers to directional sensitivity imbalance. Even with sufficient coverage, task losses can be unequally sensitive to different LoRA directions, which can distort trade-offs if ignored. Furthermore, when task preferences are specified, effective merging must preserve coverage while aligning merging weights with those preferences. Most merging methods address only one side of the problem. Task arithmetic and pruning reduce interference but erode subspace coverage and ignore direction-wise sensitivity. AdaMerging tunes global weights yet misses per-direction anisotropy. LoRA-aware methods like KnOTS and LoRA-LEGO improve structure but can shrink effective coverage and still lack sensitivity weighting. In short, they do not jointly preserve coverage and model anisotropy over LoRA directions.

基于这些观察，我们建议Building on these observations, we propose塔拉TARA，简称, short for任务等级各向异性对齐Task-Rank Anisotropy Alignment。我们的方法引入了一个结构化的合并框架，该框架明确地合并了任务偏好，同时解决了上述两个属性。它保留 LoRA 方向以维持子空间覆盖范围，并根据灵敏度通过方向重新加权来解释各向异性。然后，它将合并权重与偏好加权熵伪损失对齐，生成能够忠实地近似跨任务的微调模型的合并模型，同时提高鲁棒性和泛化性。我们在八个视觉数据集和六个自然语言推理任务中验证了我们的方法，其中. Our method introduces a structured merging framework that explicitly incorporates task preferences while addressing the two properties above. It preserves LoRA directions to maintain subspace coverage and accounts for anisotropy by direction-wise reweighting according to sensitivity. It then aligns the merging weights with a preference-weighted entropy pseudo loss, yielding merged models that faithfully approximate fine-tuned models across tasks while improving robustness and generalization. We validate our approach across eight vision datasets and six natural language inference tasks, where塔拉TARA在联合任务评估和转移到未见过的任务方面始终优于普通基线和最新的 LoRA 感知方法。consistently outperforms vanilla baselines and recent LoRA-aware methods in joint-task evaluation and transfer to unseen tasks.

我们的主要贡献总结如下：Our main contributions are summarized as follows:

  • •

    鉴定Identification of子空间覆盖subspace coverage和and各向异性anisotropy作为分析和指导 LoRA 合并的两个关键属性，突出了它们在子空间保存和方向敏感性中的作用。as two key properties for analyzing and guiding LoRA merging, highlighting their roles in subspace preservation and direction-wise sensitivity.

  • •

    简介Introduction of塔拉TARA，一个协调任务级别和排名级别偏好的框架，确保覆盖 LoRA 子空间，同时减轻各向异性引起的不平衡。, a framework that aligns both task-level and rank-level preferences, ensuring coverage of LoRA subspaces while mitigating anisotropy-induced imbalance.

  • •

    对视觉和语言基准进行广泛的实证验证，在各种实验设置中展示了最先进的性能和强大的鲁棒性。Extensive empirical validation on vision and language benchmarks, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance and strong robustness in various experimental settings.

一般模型合并会忽略 LoRA 的分解结构，并且在合并之前将适配器折叠到基础模型中时经常会遭受强烈的错位。相比之下，LoRA 感知方法对低秩因子进行操作，这对于组合更新来说既高效又更有效。在这项工作中，我们明确考虑了General model merging ignore the factorized structure of LoRA and often suffer from strong misalignment when adapters are folded into the base model before merging. In contrast, LoRA-aware methods operate on the low-rank factors, which is both efficient and more effective for combining updates. In this work we explicitly account for子空间覆盖subspace coverage和and各向异性anisotropy，LoRA 合并的两个关键方面是以前的方法在很大程度上忽视的。, two critical aspects of LoRA merging that prior methods largely overlook.

3 子空间覆盖和各向异性Subspace Coverage and Anisotropy

3.1 问题设置和符号Problem Setting and Notation

现代语言和视觉基础模型越来越多地采用 LoRA，而不是完全微调，这激发了将许多 LoRA 适配器组合成单个模型的原则性方法。在实践中，由于强烈的跨任务错位，通过将适配器折叠到基本权重中并应用模型合并来直接合并适配器通常表现不佳Modern foundation models in language and vision are increasingly adapted with LoRA rather than full fine-tuning, which motivates principled ways to combine many LoRA adapters into a single model. In practice, directly merging adapters by folding them into the base weights and applying model-merging often underperforms due to strong cross-task misalignment[79]。这些因素需要一种了解 LoRA 结构的合并方法。因此我们研究. These factors call for a merging approaches that is aware of the LoRA structure. We therefore studyLoRA合并LoRA merging，其中多个 LoRA 微调适配器被组合成一个模型，根据用户指定的偏好平衡任务性能。, where multiple LoRA fine-tuned adapters are combined into one model that balances task performance according to a user-specified preference.

由于内存使用量较低且简单，早期的免学习合并对于全参数模型很有吸引力。然而，在适应 LoRA 的环境中，即使在基础模型规模上，免学习方法和基于学习的方法之间的记忆差距也很小，因此没有理由坚持使用免学习方法。我们将其量化为Earlier learning-free mergers were attractive for full-parameter models due to lower memory use and simplicity. In LoRA-adapted settings, however, the memory gap between learning-free and learning-based approaches is small even at foundation-model scale, so there is less reason to insist on learning-free methods. 指标。Metrics.继之前的工作之后Following prior work[32, 99, 79]，我们报告每个数据集上单独微调模型的绝对精度，并使用归一化精度指标比较不同的合并方法。归一化精度定义为, we report the absolute accuracy of individually fine-tuned models on each dataset, and compare different merging methods using a normalized accuracy metric. The normalized accuracy is defined asAccuracy of merged model on task-iAccuracy of fine-tuned model on task-i\frac{\text{Accuracy of merged model on task-$i$}}{\text{Accuracy of fine-tuned model on task-$i$}}。该指标表明合并模型与每个任务的相应微调模型的性能的接近程度。. This metric indicates how closely a merged model approaches the performance of the corresponding fine-tuned model for each task.

5.1 实验结果Experimental Results

跨视觉任务的每项任务评估。Per-Task Evaluation across Vision Tasks.在这个实验中，我们采用传统的每任务评估协议In this experiments, we adopt the conventional per-task evaluation protocol[32, 99, 79]，其目标是测试不同的合并策略如何保持特定任务的性能。具体来说，将在不同数据集上独立微调的模型集合合并为一个统一模型，并在每个数据集上单独测量其性能，仅依赖于数据集自己的样本和标签。 表, where the goal is to test how well different merging strategies preserve task-specific performance. Concretely, a collection of models fine-tuned independently on separate datasets are merged into a unified model, and its performance is measured on each dataset separately, relying solely on the dataset’s own samples and labels. Table1报告了使用 CLIP 的 8 个视觉任务的标准化每任务准确度及其平均值，其中所有模型均使用 16 级 LoRA 进行了微调。我们将基线分为两组：普通合并方法和明确包含 LoRA 结构的 LoRA 感知方法。 LoRA 感知方法通常优于普通方法。例如，KnOTS-TIES 超越了 TIES，而 KnOTS-DARE-TIES 则改进了 DARE-TIES。基于 KnOTS 的变体突出了考虑 LoRA 结构的好处。 LoRA-LEGO 并没有提供比普通方法显着的优势，这表明仅保留 LoRA 1 级方向不足以在合并过程中保留特定于任务的信息。相比之下，reports normalized per-task accuracies and their averages across eight vision tasks with CLIP, where all models are fine-tuned with LoRA of rank 16. We categorize the baselines into two groups: vanilla merging methods and LoRA-aware methods that explicitly incorporate the LoRA structure. LoRA-aware methods generally outperform their vanilla counterparts. For instance, KnOTS-TIES surpasses TIES, and KnOTS-DARE-TIES improves upon DARE-TIES. KnOTS-based variants highlight the benefits of accounting for LoRA structure. LoRA-LEGO does not provide significant advantages over vanilla methods, suggesting that merely preserving LoRA rank-1 directions is insufficient to retain task-specific information during merging. By comparison,塔拉TARA始终优于 vanilla 和 LoRA 感知基线。 变体 A 通过额外的训练迭代显示出稳定的收益，从而实现更高的平均准确度。 变体 B 实现了最佳的整体权衡，仅用 250 次迭代就获得了 76.3% 的最高平均得分。 这些结果表明，利用 LoRA 结构对于稳定合并至关重要，并且consistently outperforms both vanilla and LoRA-aware baselines. Variant A shows steady gains with additional training iterations, leading to higher average accuracy. Variant B achieves the best overall trade-off, delivering the highest scores average of 76.3% with only 250 iterations. These results demonstrate that exploiting LoRA structure is essential for stable merging, and that塔拉TARA进一步有效地捕获任务敏感的子空间。实验于further effectively capture task-sensitive subspaces. 通用模型的联合任务评估。Joint-Task Evaluation of General Models.联合任务评估协议最初由The joint-task evaluation protocol, originally introduced byStoica et al. [79]，与每个任务设置不同，通过评估来自所有八个视觉基准的输入和标签的联合来评估合并模型。此设置更适合评估合并模型是否可以作为跨多个目标数据集的通用模型。在构建联合任务时，来自所有基准的标签被汇集在一起​​并删除重复项，从而形成统一的标签空间。此设置的详细说明见, differs from the per-task setup by evaluating merged models over the union of inputs and labels from all eight vision benchmarks. This setting is more suitable for assessing whether a merged model can serve as a general-purpose model across multiple target datasets. In constructing the joint task, labels from all benchmarks are pooled together and duplicates are removed, resulting in a unified label space. A detailed description of this setting is provided inSection C.4补充材料.. 表of supplementary material.. 6 结论Conclusion

我们通过两个互补的视角重新审视了 LoRA 合并：We revisited LoRA merging through two complementary lenses:子空间覆盖subspace coverage，其中 LoRA 更新共同占据一个广泛的、低冗余的子空间，而不是折叠到几个共享方向上，并且, where LoRA updates collectively occupy a wide, low-redundancy subspace rather than collapsing onto a few shared directions, and各向异性anisotropy，LoRA 1 级方向规模变化如何转化为损耗变化的方向不平衡。 忽略其中任何一个都会导致有用的子空间崩溃并使损失关键的方向产生偏差。 基于有效排名和方向敏感性分析，我们引入, the directional imbalance in how changes in the scale of LoRA rank-1 directions translate into loss changes. Ignoring either can collapse useful subspaces and bias loss-critical directions. Building on effective-rank and directional-sensitivity analyses, we introduce塔拉TARA-合并以使方向权重与任务偏好保持一致，同时保留与任务相关的子空间。 方向上的重新加权保持了高子空间覆盖率并考虑了各向异性，在每个任务、联合和转移评估中产生一致的增益。这表明解决这两个因素是稳健、通用 LoRA 合并的关键。-Merging to align direction weights with task preferences while preserving task-relevant subspaces. Direction-wise reweighting maintains high subspace coverage and accounts for anisotropy, yielding consistent gains across per-task, joint, and transfer evaluations. This demonstrates that addressing both factors is key to robust, general-purpose LoRA merging.

B 其他相关工作Additional Related Work

预合并和附加模型合并。Pre-Merging and Additional Model Merging.

合并前研究Pre-merging studies[113, 82, 111, 121]澄清并形式化线性组合行为clarify and formalize the linear-composition behavior that任务算术Task Arithmetic依赖于：他们通过部分或切线线性化来分析参数空间组合何时近似联合训练relies on: they analyze when parameter-space combinations approximate joint training via partial or tangent linearization[53, 82, 39, 68]并将它们连接到 NTK 风格的局部线性化and connect these to NTK-style local linearization[34]。在此基础上，最新的公式探索了变形金刚的最佳传输融合. Building on this foundation, recent formulations explore optimal-transport fusion for Transformers[33]，循环一致的多模型合并, cycle-consistent multi-model merging[11]，从模型内部统计数据中导出分层系数, deriving layer-wise coefficients from model-internal statistics[31]，最小二乘对齐排列, permutation with least-squares alignment[66]，从具有不同超参数的微调模型集合中构建合并配方, constructing merging recipes from collections of fine-tuned models with diverse hyperparameters[93]CLIP 的早期证据表明，平均稳健性导向的微调可以提高零样本稳健性with early evidence on CLIP that averaging robustness-oriented fine-tunes can improve zero-shot robustness[94]，配方发现的进化搜索, evolutionary search for recipe discovery[2]，稀疏性和幅度感知采样以减少干扰, sparsity- and magnitude-aware sampling to reduce interference[15]，以及由贝叶斯优化引导的动态 Fisher 加权, and dynamic Fisher weighting guided by Bayesian optimization[46]。目的. AIM[67]使用 LLM 激活空间中的信息进行合并。另一条工作利用推理或训练期间的中间激活，并使用特定层中的特征响应来指导合并过程uses the information from the activation space of LLMs for merging. Another line of work leverages intermediate activations during inference or training and uses feature responses in specific layers to guide the merging process[67, 52, 95].

额外的 LoRA 目标合并。Additional LoRA-targeted Merging.

内WithinLoRA目标LoRA-targeted方法，免训练框架在合并之前解耦方向和规模并正交化适配器方向methods, a training-free framework decouples direction and scale and orthogonalizes adapter directions before merging[115]. Zhang et al. [112]通过权重空间算法组成PEFT模块，无需额外训练即可实现灵活迁移。compose PEFT modules via weight-space arithmetic, enabling flexible transfer without extra training.Zhang and Zhou [111]强制正交 LoRA 子空间预微调，减少干扰并保持合并性能。enforce orthogonal LoRA subspaces pre-finetuning, reducing interference and preserving merge performance.Liu et al. [52]使用激活/梯度敏感性和跨任务可转移性调整任务和分层合并系数。几种直接利用低秩结构进行合并的方法adjusts task and layer-wise merging coefficients using activation/gradient sensitivity and cross-task transferability. Several methods directly exploit low-rank structure for merging[70, 23, 69]。特别是，. In particular,Panariello et al. [69]提出一个可以与现有合并基线有效组合的核心空间。propose a core space that can be efficiently combined with existing merging baselines.

LLM 和 VLM 中的模型合并。Model Merging in LLMs and VLMs.

最近关于模型合并的工作直接针对 LLM 和 VLM，并提出了针对这些架构量身定制的策略More recent work on model merging directly targets LLMs and VLMs and proposes strategies tailored to these architectures[6, 18, 58, 90, 118, 119, 109]。特别是，RobustMerge. In particular, RobustMerge[109]引入了一种 MLLM 的合并方法，该方法利用低秩空间中的方向鲁棒性。introduces a merging method for MLLMs that exploits directional robustness in a low-rank space.Zhang et al. [110]利用自注意力层的旋转对称性，与基于排列的对称性相比，这大大扩大了 Transformer 模型的等价集。leverage the rotation symmetry of self-attention layers, which substantially enlarges the equivalence set of Transformer models compared to permutation-based symmetries.

用于多任务和持续学习的模型合并。Model Merging for Multi-Task and Continual Learning.

另一条工作明确地将模型合并与传统的多任务学习联系起来Another line of work explicitly connects model merging with conventional multi-task learning[103, 102, 76, 91, 45]，将合并视为跨任务共享参数和表示整合的机制。一组互补的研究旨在定位参数中特定于任务的信息或量化线性层内的干扰, viewing merging as a mechanism for parameter sharing and representation consolidation across tasks. A complementary set of studies aims to localize task-specific information in the parameters or to quantify interference within linear layers[14, 80, 88, 9]，同时, whileMarczak et al. [60]进一步将参数空间分解为共享子空间和特定于任务的子空间。穆DSCfurther decompose the parameter space into shared and task-specific subspaces. MuDSC[98]还探索具有多种密集预测任务的异构设置，以评估合并性能。然而，它不能直接与我们的设置相比较，因为它允许类似分支的架构，例如 ZipItalso explores heterogeneous settings with diverse dense prediction tasks for evaluating merging performance. However, it is not directly comparable to our setting because it allows branch-like architectures such as ZipIt[78]。模型合并也在持续学习场景中得到了研究. Model merging has also been studied in continual learning scenarios[20, 83, 104, 87, 89, 71]，其中合并用于减轻灾难性遗忘并随着时间的推移积累跨任务的知识。, where merging is used to mitigate catastrophic forgetting and to accumulate knowledge across tasks over time.

洛拉组合物。LoRA Composition.

动态路由或专家混合组合学习在推理时组合多个 LoRADynamic routing or mixture-of-experts compositions learn to combine multiple LoRAs at inference time[96, 48, 47, 81]，少镜头动态合成改善了跨任务传输, and few-shot dynamic composition improves cross-task transfer[30, 28]。在视觉方面，用于多任务识别的多 LoRA 合并展示了模块化. In vision, multi-LoRA merging for multi-task recognition demonstrates modularity[41]。在扩散方面，多LoRA组合和主题风格概念混合进一步凸显模块化. In diffusion, multi-LoRA composition and subject-style concept mixing further highlight modularity[117, 22, 120, 122, 75, 106]。这些方法以类似 MoE 的方式为每个输入或任务动态分配或路由适配器，这改变了推理时间架构，超出了我们的范围。. These methods dynamically assign or route adapters per input or task in an MoE-like fashion, which alters the inference-time architecture and falls outside our scope.

C 实验设置Experimental Settings

C.1 数据集Datasets

C.1.1 愿景基准Vision Benchmarks

正在关注FollowingStoica et al. [79]，我们采用在 ImageNet-21k 上预训练的 ViT-B/32 主干网, we adopt a ViT-B/32 backbone pre-trained on ImageNet-21k[16]，使用 LoRA 等级 16 进行微调。评估是在八个标准图像分类数据集上进行的。下面提供了简要总结。, fine-tuned with LoRA rank 16. Evaluation is conducted on eight standard image-classification datasets. Brief summaries are provided below.

太阳397SUN397[97].大规模场景识别数据集，包含 397 个类别和 108,754 张图像，每个类别至少有 100 个样本。Large-scale scene recognition dataset with 397 categories and 108,754 images, each class having at least 100 samples.

汽车Cars[43].细粒度汽车识别涵盖 196 个类别，16,185 张图像，均匀分为训练和测试。Fine-grained car recognition covering 196 categories with 16,185 images, evenly split into train and test.

RESISC45 [8].遥感基准，包含 45 个场景类和 31,500 张图像，每类约 700 张。Remote sensing benchmark with 45 scene classes and 31,500 images, about 700 per class.

欧洲卫星公司EuroSAT[27].卫星图像分类数据集，包含不同地区 10 个土地利用类别的 27,000 张图像。Satellite image classification dataset of 27,000 images in 10 land-use categories across diverse regions.

SVHN [108].街景门牌数据集，包含 10 位数字类别、73,257 个训练图像、26,032 个测试图像和 500k+ 额外样本。Street View House Numbers dataset with 10 digit classes, 73,257 train images, 26,032 test images, and 500k+ extra samples.

GTSRB [77].交通标志识别数据集，包含 43 个类别和超过 50,000 张标记图像。Traffic sign recognition dataset with 43 categories and over 50,000 labeled images.

MNIST [44].经典手写数字数据集，包含 70,000 张灰度图像，均匀分布在 10 个类别中（60k 训练/10k 测试）。Classic handwritten digit dataset of 70,000 grayscale images evenly distributed across 10 classes (60k train / 10k test).

DTD [10].纹理分类数据集，包含 47 个属性和 5,640 张图像，每类约 120 张。Texture classification dataset with 47 attributes and 5,640 images, about 120 per class.

C.1.2 语言基准Language Benchmarks

除了本文中使用的主要基准之外，我们还在六个分类数据集上评估了我们的方法，以评估其对大型语言模型的适用性。这些数据集与 LLaMA-3 8B 模型结合使用。下面，我们简要总结每个数据集。In addition to the main benchmarks used in the paper, we evaluate our method on six classification datasets to assess its applicability to large language models. These datasets are used in conjunction with the LLaMA-3 8B model. Below, we briefly summarize each dataset.

QNLI [85].问答数据集重新表述为句子对分类。每个示例都是一个（问题，句子）对，标签指示该句子是否包含问题的答案（二进制）。A question-answering dataset reformulated as sentence-pair classification. Each example is a (question, sentence) pair, and the label indicates whether the sentence contains the answer to the question (binary).

MNLI [92].用于自然语言推理注释的大型众包句子对集合。给定前提和假设，任务是预测三个标签之一：A large, crowdsourced collection of sentence pairs annotated for natural language inference. Given a premise and a hypothesis, the task is to predict one of three labels:蕴涵entailment, 矛盾contradiction, 或, or中立的neutral（三级）。(three-class).

SNLI [4].语料库A corpus of∼\sim570k 人类书写的句子对标记为570k human-written sentence pairs labeled for蕴涵entailment, 矛盾contradiction, 或, or中立的neutral，支持标准NLI任务（三级）。, supporting the standard NLI task (three-class).

即时通讯RTE[12, 26, 24, 3].根据 RTE1、RTE2、RTE3 和 RTE5 挑战编译的一套文本蕴含数据集。例子来自新闻和维基百科。在 GLUE 公式中，所有 RTE 集都通过折叠转换为二元分类A suite of textual entailment datasets compiled from the RTE1, RTE2, RTE3, and RTE5 challenges. Examples are drawn from news and Wikipedia. In the GLUE formulation, all RTE sets are converted to binary classification by collapsing中立的neutral和and矛盾contradiction进入into非蕴涵not-entailment为了一致性。for consistency.

西克SICK[61].由图像和视频字幕构建的约 10k 个句子对的数据集。每对都被标记为语义相关性（1-5 级）和三个类别的文本蕴涵：A dataset of around 10k sentence pairs built from image and video captions. Each pair is labeled for semantic relatedness (1-5 scale) and for textual entailment with three classes:蕴涵entailment, 矛盾contradiction, 和, and中立的neutral。它广泛用于评估统一环境中的组合语义、蕴含和相似性。. It is widely used for evaluating compositional semantics, entailment, and similarity in a unified setting.

科学尾巴SciTail[42].来自多项选择科学考试和网络句子的蕴含数据集。每个（前提，假设）对被标记为An entailment dataset derived from multiple-choice science exams and web sentences. Each (premise, hypothesis) pair is labeled as需要entails or 中立的neutral（二进制）。该数据集包含 27,026 个示例（10,101(binary). The dataset contains 27,026 examples (10,101需要entails和 16,925and 16,925中立的neutral).

C.2 培训详情Training Details

对于视觉任务，我们微调了 CLIPFor the vision tasks, we fine-tuned CLIP[72]具有 ViT-B/32 主干。 所有模型均使用 AdamW 进行优化with a ViT-B/32 backbone. All models were optimized using AdamW[55]学习率为 3e-4 和余弦学习率调度程序with a learning rate of 3e-4 and a cosine learning rate scheduler[54]权重衰减为 1e-4。with a weight decay of 1e-4.

对于序列分类，我们对 LLaMA-3 进行了微调For sequence classification, we fine-tuned LLaMA-3[19]使用 8B 参数，按照以下设置with 8B parameters, following the setup of[79]。 优化使用学习率为 3e-5 的 AdamW 和线性调度器。 添加了具有三个输出的线性分类头用于自然语言推理（蕴涵、矛盾、中性），并且在二进制设置中忽略未使用类的预测。. Optimization used AdamW with a learning rate of 3e-5 and a linear scheduler. A linear classification head with three outputs was added for natural language inference (entailment, contradiction, neutral), and in binary settings predictions for the unused class were disregarded.

为了实现高效的适应，我们应用了LoRATo enable efficient adaptation, we applied LoRA[29]CLIP 和 LLaMA。 具体来说，低等级适配器被附加到每个变压器块的查询、键、值和输出投影矩阵。 除非另有说明，默认的 LoRA 超参数为：rank = 16，to both CLIP and LLaMA. Specifically, low-rank adapters were attached to the query, key, value, and output projection matrices of each transformer block. Unless otherwise stated, the default LoRA hyperparameters were: rank = 16,α\alpha= 16，辍学率 = 0.1。= 16, and dropout = 0.1.

C.4 每个任务和联合任务评估Per-Task and Joint-Task Evaluation

除了标准的每任务基准之外，我们还采用了由In addition to the standard per-task benchmark, we also adopt the “joint-task” evaluation introduced byStoica et al. [79]。与每个任务机制不同的是，每个数据集都是独立处理的，联合任务将所有八个视觉基准的输入和标签聚合到一个评估池中。合并所有标签集后，重复的类将被删除（例如，MNIST. Unlike the per-task regime, where each dataset is treated independently, the joint-task aggregates the inputs and labels from all eight vision benchmarks into a single evaluation pool. After combining all label sets, duplicate classes are removed (for example, MNIST[44]和SVHNand SVHN[108]共享相同的数字类别），从而在合并基准中产生 748 个唯一标签。这种设置要求特别高，因为模型不仅必须在任务中进行泛化，还必须区分不同数据集中出现的标签。在某些情况下，标签在语义上接近或分层，例如 SUN397 中的“islet”share the same digit categories), resulting in 748 unique labels across the combined benchmark. This setup is particularly demanding because models must not only generalize within a task, but also discriminate among labels that appear across different datasets. In some cases, labels are semantically close or hierarchical, such as “islet” in SUN397[97]以及 RESISC45 中的“岛”and “island” in RESISC45[8]，增加了分类的难度。为了解释这种歧义，使用 Hits@ 报告评估, which increases the difficulty of classification. To account for such ambiguity, evaluation is reported using Hits@kk指标，其中 Hits@1 对应于 top-1 准确率及更高metrics, where Hits@1 corresponds to top-1 accuracy and higherkk当正确的标签出现在顶部时，值允许部分计分values allow partial credit when the correct label appears among the top-kk预测。联合任务协议是评估合并模型通用性的重要基准，因为它直接测试单个模型是否可以跨多个数据集的不同标签空间运行。predictions. Joint-task protocol serves as an important benchmark for assessing the generality of merged models, as it directly tests whether a single model can operate across the diverse label space of multiple datasets.

F.1 基线比较的扩展分析Extended Analysis of Baseline Comparisons

在本节中，我们对主论文中提出的基线比较进行更详细的分析。我们详细阐述了视觉和自然语言推理 (NLI) 领域的每个任务性能指标，对最近的普通和 LoRA 感知合并方法的行为进行了扩展检查。In this section, we provide a more detailed analysis of the baseline comparisons presented in the main paper. We elaborate on the per-task performance metrics across both vision and natural language inference (NLI) domains, offering an extended examination of the behavior of recent vanilla and LoRA-aware merging methods.

跨视觉任务的每项任务评估。Per-Task Evaluation across Vision Tasks.对于八个图像分类基准，For the eight image-classification benchmarks,Tab. 1报告微调 LoRA 检查点的绝对每任务精度和合并模型的标准化精度。强大的普通合并方法，例如 Iso-CTSreports both the absolute per-task accuracies of the fine-tuned LoRA checkpoints and the normalized accuracies of the merged models. Strong vanilla merging methods such as Iso-CTS[60]平均达到微调性能的 73.5%，但仍然落后于微调基线，并且在数据集之间显示出很大的差异。在 LoRA 感知方法中，KnOTS-TIESreach up to 73.5% of the fine-tuned performance on average, but still lag behind the fine-tuned baselines and show large variance across datasets. Among LoRA-aware approaches, KnOTS-TIES[79]提供最强的基线，而 RobustMergeprovides the strongest baseline, whereas RobustMerge[109]产生明显较弱的平均性能和较小的增益，表明其稳健性优势在这种情况下受到限制。在这些基线之上，yields noticeably weaker average performance and smaller gains, indicating that its robustness benefits are limited in this setting. On top of these baselines,塔拉TARA-变体A和-Variant A and塔拉TARA-变体 B 进一步将平均归一化准确率分别提高到 74.0% 和 76.3%，并具有一致的增益，这表明我们的方法在合并多个检查点时比最近的合并基线更好地保留了每个任务的性能。-Variant B further improve the average normalized accuracy to 74.0% and 76.3%, respectively, with consistent gains, showing that our method better preserves per-task performance when merging multiple checkpoints than more recent merging baselines.

法学硕士对 6 个 NLI 任务的按任务评估。Per-Task Evaluation on 6 NLI Tasks with LLMs.对于六个 NLI 基准，For the six NLI benchmarks,Tab. 2显示与基于 CLIP 的视觉设置不同的图片。虽然 Iso-Cshows a different picture from CLIP-based vision settings. Although Iso-C[60]在视觉基准上表现强劲，在 NLI 设置中，它产生了高度不平衡的结果：它在 SCITAIL 上达到了超过 100% 的微调精度，但在其他任务上却大幅下降，导致其平均值在最近的普通基线中最低。 EMR-合并performs strongly on vision benchmarks, in the NLI setting it produces highly unbalanced results: it attains more than 100% of the fine-tuned accuracy on SCITAIL, but suffers large drops on the other tasks, leading to the lowest average among recent vanilla baselines. EMR-Merging[31]和 FR 合并and FR-Merging[116]，这在传统的基于 CLIP 的多任务设置中是有效的，也无法干净地转移到法学硕士，并且在该体系中没有达到有竞争力的平均水平。 LoRA 感知方法通常比普通合并有所改进，但 RobustMerge 相对于更简单的 LoRA 感知基线仅提供适度的增益，平均归一化精度的改进有限。相比之下，我们的, which are effective in conventional CLIP-based multi-task setups, also fail to transfer cleanly to LLMs and do not achieve competitive averages in this regime. LoRA-aware methods generally improve over vanilla merging, but RobustMerge offers only modest gains over simpler LoRA-aware baselines, with limited improvement in average normalized accuracy. In contrast, our塔拉TARA-变体A和-Variant A and塔拉TARA-变体 B 的平均标准化准确度分别达到 79.7% 和 80.3%，优于所有普通和 LoRA 感知基线。这些结果表明，针对基于 CLIP 的模型量身定制的方法不会自动延续到法学硕士，而我们的方法可以从视觉到语言任务稳健地扩展。-Variant B reach 79.7% and 80.3% average normalized accuracy, respectively, outperforming all vanilla and LoRA-aware baselines. These results indicate that methods tailored to CLIP-based models do not automatically carry over to LLMs, while our approach scales robustly from vision to language tasks.

Even for large models such as LLaMA-3-8B and LLaVA-1.5-7B, a merge completes within 30 minutes, underscoring the practical applicability of塔拉TARA.

为了补充对基础模型的分析，我们还评估了相对轻量级视觉目标的计算效率。To complement the analysis on foundation models, we also evaluate computational efficiency on relatively lightweight vision targets.Table 7使用 ViT-B/32 主干报告时间和内存成本。与大型模型中观察到的趋势一致，免学习方法（例如 KnOTS-TIES、LoRA-LEGO）的运行时间仅代表一次验证通过。由于实际部署需要网格搜索来找到最佳缩放因子，因此它们的总运行时间通常超过单次运行优化时间reports the time and memory costs using the ViT-B/32 backbone. Consistent with the trends observed in larger models, the runtimes for learning-free methods (e.g., KnOTS-TIES, LoRA-LEGO) represent only a single validation pass. Because practical deployment requires grid searches to find optimal scaling factors, their total operational time typically exceeds the single-run optimization time of塔拉TARA。关于内存消耗，虽然较小的 ViT-B/32 架构上的免学习方法和基于梯度的方法之间在 VRAM 使用方面存在明显差距，但这种差异在基础模型规模上会减小（如 LLaMA-3 所示）。由于冻结的基本权重在大型模型的整体内存占用中占主导地位，因此梯度计算引入的相对开销变得不那么明显。. Regarding memory consumption, while a distinct gap in VRAM usage exists between learning-free and gradient-based methods on the smaller ViT-B/32 architecture, this discrepancy diminishes at the foundation-model scale (as seen with LLaMA-3). Since frozen base weights dominate the overall memory footprint of large models, the relative overhead introduced by gradient computation becomes less pronounced.
